definitions.explanation: A round or circular shape. Often used as a modifier to describe something that is circular in form.

examples.japanese: {円形|えんけい}のテーブルを{使|つか}う。
{広場|ひろば}の{中央|ちゅうおう}に{円形|えんけい}の{噴水|ふんすい}がある。
examples.english: There is a circular fountain in the center of the plaza.

examples.japanese: {円形|えんけい}{脱毛症|だつもうしょう}はストレスが{原因|げんいん}で{起|お}こることがある。
examples.english: Alopecia areata can be caused by stress.

notes:
Typically used as a modifier (の or compound) before another noun. Rarely appears as a standalone noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{円形|えんけい}の (circular, round)
・{円形|えんけい}{脱毛症|だつもうしょう} (alopecia areata, spot baldness)
・{円形|えんけい}{劇場|げきじょう} (amphitheater)
・{円形|えんけい}{交差点|こうさてん} (roundabout, traffic circle)

RELATED SHAPES:
・{三角形|さんかくけい} (triangle)
・{四角形|しかくけい} (quadrilateral)
・{長方形|ちょうほうけい} (rectangle)
・{楕円形|だえんけい} (ellipse, oval)
